headline: Luftwaffe Unleashes Massive Air Assault on Britain in Bid to Break RAF
dispatch: German air fleets crossed the Channel in unprecedented numbers on August 13, striking airfields and radar stations across southern England in the operation commanders called Eagle Day. RAF Fighter Command scrambled hundreds of Hurricanes and Spitfires to meet the onslaught, and fierce combats raged from Kent to Hampshire. The Luftwaffe lost far more aircraft than anticipated, and the planned knockout blow against British air power fell well short of its mark.
answer: Luftwaffe launches Adlertag to destroy the RAF, 1940
